enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +29: Passive: +29 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Radiance Lore +21: Passive: Your Light and Aligned spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Radiance +142: Passive: +142 Equipment bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.
Insightful Radiance +71: Passive: +71 Insight bonus to Light and Alignment Spell Power.
Insightful Wizardry +134: +134 Insight bonus to spell points.
Malleable: This item has a magical aura of malleability and can be combined with any item that has the Fusible property to create a new, more powerful fusion of the two items.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
